method: Root inspected all 59 matched final-movie frame pairs across 10 sheets, covering all 20 shots, eye closure/opening, frozen flash, both two-frame impacts, cassette handoff, PLAY/tracking, dawn and launch. Both movies decoded at identical quantized timestamps.
audio_evidence: All 8 newly synthesized exact published voice inputs independently Whisper-normalized exact; original voices/speeds/onsets and dispatcher radio filtering retained. New 116 BPM city-pop score: 2441 notes, 435 hits and 50 material effects; full silence, cockpit music bandwidth and launch semitone lift preserved. AAC measured -14 LUFS and -1.2 dBTP.
comparison_notes: Source-informed full 59-second reconstruction with credited shared cel character, prop and procedural background factories. All 20 scenes are newly assembled; fresh voice, score and Foley. Fine cloud/window placement, rain/reflection, suspension/spray, gauge recoil and musical phrasing differ. This is a reconstruction study, not a blind model benchmark.
